usageNotes: Use this to audit all scheduled realm-sync jobs across the cluster — useful before adding a new job to avoid duplicates, or to confirm a job is enabled and scheduled correctly. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path ('/'); API tokens are supported. The response includes last-run and next-run timestamps (Unix epoch), so no additional calls are needed to determine job health at a glance.
tips: last-run and next-run are Unix timestamps — convert with 'date -d @<timestamp>' or equivalent to get human-readable times.
A job with enabled=false will not run on its schedule but remains configured; useful for temporarily suspending sync without deleting the job.
The remove-vanished field defaults to 'none' when not set, meaning stale users/groups are never pruned automatically — review this on each job if directory hygiene matters.
Use the returned 'id' values to target specific jobs via the per-job endpoints (read, update, delete, or run).
